hero.badge: Focus sessions that grow something real
hero.subtitle: FocusFlow turns every task into a focus session. Finish one and you earn silver, EXP and items to build your own isometric garden — one deep-work block at a time.
hero.note: Free to start. No credit card needed.

features.title: Everything a focus session needs
features.subtitle: Plan the work, protect the time, and keep the reward for finishing what you started.

task.title: Tasks with intent
task.desc: Write the task, break it into todos, set the duration. A daily quota keeps your list honest instead of endless.

focus.title: One timer, one task
focus.desc: A single focus screen with a countdown ring, quick notes and nothing else. Pause, extend or give up — the server keeps the time, not the tab.

reward.title: Rewards you earn
reward.desc: Every completed session rolls for silver, EXP and garden items. Give up and you pay for it — that is what makes finishing feel good.

garden.title: A garden that remembers
garden.desc: Place what you earn on an isometric plot. Your garden becomes the record of every hour you actually focused.

step1.title: Create a task
step1.desc: Give it a title, a duration and the todos that make it real.

step2.title: Run the session
step2.desc: Start the timer and stay with one thing until it rings.

step3.title: Collect the reward
step3.desc: Submit the task and roll for silver, EXP and items.

step4.title: Grow the garden
step4.desc: Place your items and watch the plot fill up week after week.

cta.title: Your garden starts with one session
cta.subtitle: Create an account, plant the first seed, and let your focused hours show for something.

footer.tagline: Focus sessions that grow a garden.
